title: A small speck on a television screen
global_prompt: Four five-second shots alternate between the television image and the surrounding living room, following the viewers' inspection, the removal of the small speck, and their reactions.

observed_facts.text: A cool monochrome television image fills the frame with horizontal scan lines. The dark-haired woman occupies the right; a partial reflected view and curved decorative border appear at left.
The woman's head changes from left-facing profile to nearly frontal between frames 0 and 1, then remains nearly unchanged through frame 4.
A small dark speck is visible over the woman's nose while her eyes are wide and her lips slightly parted.

shots.observed_camera: Tight screen-image close-up with no television casing visible. No camera movement is established; the head orientation changes within a consistent composition.
shots.action_temporality: An early head turn is supported by frames 0–1, followed by a sustained nearly still pose in frames 1–4.
uncertainties: Sampling cannot distinguish an actual paused image from a very still held pose.
shots.generation_prompt_en: For five seconds, fill the view with the curved-screen television's cool monochrome picture and fine horizontal scan lines. The televised dark-haired woman has straight dark hair with blunt bangs, dark clothing, and a light collar. Beside a curved reflective border and a partial reflection at left, she turns from a left-facing profile toward a nearly frontal, wide-eyed stare, her lips slightly parted. A tiny dark speck remains on the glass over her nose. Hold the frontal image nearly still for the rest of the shot.

adaptations.text: Extend the source's approximately 3.59 seconds to five seconds by lengthening the supported final hold.

observed_facts.text: Three viewers stand beside a large curved-screen television at right in a warmly lit room with pale walls, a cushioned sofa, framed branch artwork, a textured doorway, and a lit lamp. The screen shows the same dark-haired woman.
The blonde viewer in a beige coat raises and extends her right hand toward the television, leaning and moving closer between frames 0 and 4.
The bald viewer in a black leather coat, burgundy vest, and gold tie watches beside the curly-haired viewer in green. She tilts her head and brings both hands to her hips by frame 4.

shots.observed_camera: Approximately eye-level medium-wide group view, with the viewers across the left and center and the angled television dominating the right foreground. Framing remains stable.
shots.action_temporality: The blonde viewer's reach progresses throughout the samples; the curly-haired viewer's hands move from her sides to her hips near the end.
uncertainties: The final sample shows a reach toward the screen without confirming contact.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In a warmly lit living room, the blonde viewer, a light-skinned woman with layered shoulder-length hair and a beige belted coat, stands at left beside the bald viewer, a dark-skinned man in a black leather coat, burgundy vest, dark shirt, and patterned gold tie. The curly-haired viewer, a medium-brown-skinned woman with copper curls, a green collared dress with dark side panels, and glasses hanging at her chest, stands nearest the large curved-screen television at right. Its monochrome screen holds the televised dark-haired woman's frontal face. Over five seconds, the blonde viewer leans closer and extends her right hand toward the glass. The bald viewer watches; the curly-haired viewer tilts her head and places both hands on her hips. Keep the sofa, branch artwork, textured doorway, and glowing lamp softly visible behind them.

adaptations.text: Slow the approximately 3.04-second reach and accompanying posture changes to occupy five seconds, ending before contact.

observed_facts.text: A tighter television-screen insert shows the same nearly motionless frontal face, horizontal scan lines, partial reflection at left, and dark speck over the nose.

A natural-color hand enters from below, brings thumb and index finger together over the speck, then holds the tiny dark piece between fingertips slightly left of its initial position, leaving the depicted nose clear.

shots.observed_camera: Fixed extreme close view of the screen surface; the entering hand partly obscures the face. No camera movement is evidenced.
shots.action_temporality: Frames 0–4 support approach, pinching contact, and separation of the speck from its original screen position.
uncertainties: The isolated hand's owner and the speck's material are not independently identifiable in this shot.
shots.generation_prompt_en: A tight five-second insert of the curved-screen television shows the televised dark-haired woman's nearly still frontal face in cool monochrome, crossed by prominent horizontal scan lines. Retain the partial reflected image and curved border at the left edge. A natural-color hand rises from the bottom foreground toward the dark speck on the glass over her nose. Thumb and index finger pinch the speck and lift it away from that position, ending with the tiny dark piece visibly held between the fingertips and the pictured nose clear. The underlying face remains still.

adaptations.text: Stretch the approximately 2.79-second approach and pinch to five seconds, preserving the observed order and final fingertip hold.

observed_facts.text: The room view returns with the same television, three viewers, sofa, branch artwork, textured doorway, and lamp. The televised woman's frontal face remains on screen.
The blonde viewer begins leaning toward the screen with her right hand at the glass, then withdraws it in a pinched-finger pose, straightens, and looks toward her raised fingertips.

By the last frame the blonde viewer has lowered her hand and tilted her face upward, mouth open. The curly-haired viewer keeps both hands on her hips and also glances upward; the bald viewer remains between them with a furrowed expression.

shots.observed_camera: Stable medium-wide room view resembling Shot2, with the blonde viewer initially prominent in the left foreground and the television at right.
shots.action_temporality: Hand withdrawal and straightening precede the final lowered-hand, upward-looking pose. No airborne object's trajectory is established.
uncertainties: No small item can be resolved reliably between the fingertips in this wider shot.
The upward gaze targets are outside the supplied view.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Return to the warm living-room group view for five seconds, with the curved-screen television at right still showing the televised dark-haired woman's monochrome frontal face. The blonde viewer begins bent forward, her right fingertips at the glass. She pulls her hand back with thumb and index finger pinched, straightens, and studies her raised fingertips with her mouth partly open. Behind her, the bald viewer watches with a furrowed expression, while the curly-haired viewer stands with both hands planted on her hips. Near the end, the blonde viewer lowers her hand and tilts her open-mouthed face upward; the curly-haired viewer also glances upward. Preserve their clothing and the sofa, framed branch artwork, textured doorway, and lit lamp from the earlier room view.

adaptations.text: Use the source's approximately five-second timing, retaining visible hand and gaze changes without specifying an unresolved tiny object or its trajectory.

title: A mechanical figure among miniature botanical displays
global_prompt: Four five-second shots move from a red display detail to the figure approaching the central white display, a restrained hand gesture, and a close-up of its turning head.

observed_facts.text: The red botanical sculpture sits in its black pot on a rough white rectangular pedestal; red curved stalks and thin looping wires stand out against a dark background.
All five samples retain the same close composition, shallow focus and subdued directional lighting, with no discernible sculpture action or internal edited view change.

shots.observed_camera: Stable close-up, viewed slightly down toward the pot and pedestal, with the sculpture near center and the room deeply blurred.
shots.action_temporality: The sampled interval supports a sustained still display view.
uncertainties: Small motion between samples cannot be excluded.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In a dim miniature botanical display room, hold a close view of the Red botanical sculpture: glossy curved red stalks, fine reddish wire loops and dark tips rising from a small angular black pot with a gold-colored accent. It rests on a rough white rectangular pedestal. Shallow focus isolates the intricate forms against the nearly black room, while soft directional light catches their red surfaces and the pedestal's uneven edges. Sustain this quiet, still composition for five seconds.

adaptations.text: Extend the approximately 1.42-second source display hold to five seconds.

observed_facts.text: The room contains five white display pedestals, a rectangular gridded window at left and a large round gridded window behind the figure. Foliage crosses the pale upper wall, and blue textured terrain borders the gray floor.
The mechanical figure wears pale short sleeves, dark purple straps and a dark waist garment, with exposed gray jointed limbs and a cloth-covered face beneath its rounded crown.
Initially seen from behind near center, the figure changes foot placement and turns through a screen-right-facing profile, then ends facing forward behind the foremost white sculpture.
The white sculpture stays on the central foreground pedestal and the red sculpture remains at right. The room framing is stable throughout the five samples.

shots.observed_camera: Wide, stable frontal room view with the figure framed among the plinths. The change from Shot1 is a distinct cut to a wider view.
shots.action_temporality: Ordered poses support a short stepping and turning movement ending in a frontal stance. The central plinth partly occludes the legs.
uncertainties: The complete foot trajectory is not visible behind the foreground pedestal.
shots.generation_prompt_en: A wide view reveals the miniature display room, its pale circular and rectangular gridded windows, trailing wall foliage, and gray floor edged by dark blue textured terrain. Among the white pedestals stands the Cloth-faced mechanical figure, an articulated gray humanoid with a rounded silver-gray crown, a white cloth face covering, pale short sleeves, purple shoulder straps and a dark waist garment. Starting with its back toward the viewer, it takes a few small, deliberate steps and turns through a right-facing profile to face forward behind the White botanical sculpture, a cluster of irregular white petals in a black angular pot on the foremost pedestal. The Red botanical sculpture stays on the right-hand pedestal. Finish with the figure standing still, its arms lowered, in the same fixed room composition.

adaptations.text: Stretch the observed stepping and turning sequence from approximately 2.58 seconds to five seconds; avoid prescribing obscured footwork.

observed_facts.text: The figure faces forward behind the white sculpture, with the white pedestal and black pot prominent in the foreground. Red and orange botanical displays flank it, while rear white plinths are blurred.

The figure's right hand, on screen-left, rises from its side and extends toward the white sculpture. Its segmented fingers change curl and remain beside the petals; no clear contact, grasp or displacement is shown.
The figure's other hand remains lowered, and the white sculpture and its pot retain their position throughout the stable medium view.

shots.observed_camera: A cut to a closer frontal medium composition, slightly looking down onto the white display, with shallow depth of field and no discernible camera movement.
shots.action_temporality: The five frames show a restrained hand lift and finger adjustment, without a completed pickup or visible manipulation of the sculpture.
uncertainties: Minute contact cannot be resolved; the prompt uses a hovering gesture.
shots.generation_prompt_en: The Cloth-faced mechanical figure stands behind the White botanical sculpture in the dim display room. Its pale fabric top, purple straps and articulated gray hands contrast with the delicate white petal forms and small black pot on the rough white pedestal. Slowly lift its right hand, visible on the left side of the image, toward the sculpture, gently adjusting the segmented fingers and holding the hand beside the petals. Keep a small visible gap between hand and sculpture; the pot and petals remain still. Its other arm stays lowered. The Red botanical sculpture and an orange pointed display flank the figure in the softly blurred background.

adaptations.text: Retiming the approximately 1.96-second gesture to five seconds allows a slow lift and brief hold.
Specify a small hand-to-petal gap as conservative staging because the samples show no clear contact.

observed_facts.text: A close view emphasizes the figure's smooth silver-gray crown, gold-brown textured patch, fringed white cloth face covering, pale woven top, small metal fasteners and purple shoulder straps.

The head starts near frontal, angles slightly toward screen-right, returns near center, turns more clearly toward screen-left, and returns near frontal. The torso remains approximately forward-facing.
The close composition remains stable, with blurred white pedestals, the dark lower wall and indistinct upper-wall foliage behind the figure.

shots.observed_camera: A distinct cut to a stable chest-up close-up, centered on the figure with shallow background focus.
shots.action_temporality: The ordered samples support small alternating head turns and a return toward center, without establishing any gaze target.
uncertainties: Eyes are not visible and no target or purpose for the head turns can be established.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Frame the Cloth-faced mechanical figure chest-up in the same dim miniature display room. Soft overhead light glints on its smooth silver-gray crown and reveals the gold-brown textured patch above its fringed white cloth face covering. Preserve the coarse weave of the pale top, small metal fasteners and dark purple shoulder straps. With its torso nearly still and facing forward, the figure angles its head slightly toward screen-right, returns toward center, turns toward screen-left, then settles facing forward. Blurred white plinths and the dark wall remain behind it throughout the five-second close-up.

adaptations.text: Lengthen the approximately 2.79-second series of small head turns to five seconds without adding a gaze target or motive.

title: Seated exchange beside a window
global_prompt: Six five-second shots preserve the window-side exchange: the man's shifting gaze, a brief reach during the woman's phone handling, her emphatic gestures, his attentive reaction, her steady look, and his final downward gaze.

observed_facts.text: The young man wears a pale yellow sweater; his swept black hair, ear stud and sparse chin hair are visible against a softly blurred window and pale curtain.
Across the samples he tilts his head, turns toward screen left with raised shoulders, then turns back and lowers his gaze toward screen right. His lips change position.

shots.observed_camera: Tight head-and-shoulders view with shallow background focus. The same window background persists; no internal edited view or definite camera movement is evident.
shots.action_temporality: Ordered samples support successive head and gaze changes, but not their exact intervening trajectories.
uncertainties: No audible words or specific offscreen gaze target are established.
shots.generation_prompt_en: A tight portrait beside a softly blurred window and pale curtain shows the Young man in yellow: medium-brown skin, thick swept-up black hair, a small bright ear stud, sparse chin hair and a pale yellow V-neck sweater. Over five seconds he tilts his head with parted lips, turns toward the left with his shoulders slightly raised, then turns back and lets his gaze drop toward the right. Keep the performance restrained and the window softly out of focus.

adaptations.text: Compress the sampled 5.6-second head-and-gaze sequence into five seconds without specifying dialogue.

observed_facts.text: The man sits on the left and the woman on the right beside a broad window with dark frames, metal grilles, greenery and hanging pots. She wears a white-floral blue dress with a waist tie, glasses on her head and jewelry.

The woman looks down at a dark phone held between her hands while the man extends an arm toward her side. She then turns toward him, drawing one arm across her chest toward her opposite shoulder; his hand subsequently rests lower between them.

shots.observed_camera: Stable medium two-shot from approximately seated eye level. No sampled internal cut or camera movement is evident.
shots.action_temporality: The samples support phone handling, the man's reach, and their subsequent facing poses. The phone becomes obscured at the right side.
uncertainties: The reach does not establish contact, a phone transfer or the phone's exact later position.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In the same bright window-side room, the Young man in yellow sits on the left beside the Woman in blue on the right. She has a dark ponytail, light-framed glasses atop her head, hoop earrings, a nose ring, rings and a red wrist cord; her blue dress has small white flowers and a white waist tie. Grilled windows, leafy greenery and hanging pots fill the background. During five seconds she looks down and handles the Dark smartphone between her hands. He leans toward her and extends a hand toward her side. She turns to face him with one arm drawn across her chest toward her opposite shoulder, while his extended hand lowers between them. Keep the phone with her, without a handover.

adaptations.text: Slightly extend the 4.6-second sequence and simplify the reach without asserting contact. Retain the woman's phone possession as it continues into Shot3.

observed_facts.text: The woman is in focus beyond the man's blurred head and yellow shoulder at left. A red-shaded lamp, glass shelf, wall decorations and black chair appear behind her.
Holding the phone in her left hand, she points toward its lit screen, opens her right hand toward the man, then draws that hand back near her chest. Her eyes widen and her mouth changes shape.

shots.observed_camera: Over the man's shoulder, framing the woman in a medium close-up. Stable background and consistent focus; no internal cut is evident.
shots.action_temporality: The ordered frames support a screen-directed gesture, an outward open-hand gesture and a return toward her chest.
uncertainties: The phone display is not legible; mouth movements do not establish dialogue.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Over the blurred yellow shoulder and dark hair of the Young man in yellow, frame the Woman in blue in the same room, with a red-shaded lamp and glass shelf behind her. Across five seconds she holds the Dark smartphone in her left hand, points toward its illuminated but unreadable screen with her right, then opens that hand toward him before bringing it back near her chest. Her eyebrows rise, eyes widen and lips move through the emphatic exchange. Preserve her glasses atop her ponytail and visible rings.

adaptations.text: Spread the 3.36-second gesture sequence across five seconds with brief holds, without adding words or screen content.

observed_facts.text: The man is in focus facing the woman, whose ponytail, glasses and blue shoulder fill the soft right foreground. Dark window frames, grilles and a pale curtain remain behind him.
The man maintains his gaze toward her with slightly raised brows and parted lips while her raised hand changes between downward and sideways pointing positions.

shots.observed_camera: Reverse medium close-up favoring the man with the woman blurred in the right foreground. No evident internal cut or camera movement.
shots.action_temporality: A sustained reaction accompanies several sampled foreground hand positions.
uncertainties: The exact connecting finger movements are unsampled.
shots.generation_prompt_en: The Young man in yellow watches the Woman in blue beside the dark-framed window and pale curtain. His brows are slightly raised and his lips remain gently parted. Her ponytail, glasses and blue patterned shoulder occupy the softly blurred right foreground, with her ringed hand making a small downward then sideways pointing gesture between them. Let his attentive gaze hold through this five-second reaction shot, keeping focus on his face.

adaptations.text: Extend the 2.72-second reaction to five seconds and reduce the sampled hand gestures to one short downward-to-sideways sequence.

observed_facts.text: The view returns to the woman with the man blurred at left; the same red lamp, glass shelf and black chair are behind her. A portion of the dark phone is visible at the bottom edge.

shots.action_temporality: The pointing gesture settles before the man's foreground head turn and the woman's final head tilt.

shots.generation_prompt_en: Back on the Woman in blue with the red lamp and glass shelf behind her, the Young man in yellow remains softly blurred at the left edge. adaptations.text: Extend the 3.84-second sequence to five seconds by holding the final look; leave the mostly cropped phone low.

observed_facts.text: A tight view isolates the man's face and yellow shoulders against a blurred pale curtain, window and warm-colored wall decorations.
His initially sideways gaze lowers, his parted lips close and his chin dips. His eyelids are closed in the final sample.

shots.observed_camera: Stable tight close-up with shallow depth of field. No sampled internal cut or definite camera movement.
shots.action_temporality: Multiple ordered frames support the lowering gaze and chin. The final closed eyelids may represent a blink rather than sustained closure.
uncertainties: Duration of the final eyelid closure is unknown.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In a tight close-up in the same window-side room, the Young man in yellow holds his shoulders slightly forward. His swept hair and bright ear stud stand out against the blurred curtain and window. During five seconds his sideways gaze gradually drops, his lips close and his chin dips. End with a brief closing of his eyelids, keeping the expression restrained.

adaptations.text: Compress 5.36 seconds to five; stage the final sampled closed eyelids as a brief closure without implying prolonged eye closure.

title: Restaurant table exchange
global_prompt: Six five-second shots preserve the restaurant exchange: the man tastes from his spoon, the woman gestures questioningly, he glances upward, she gestures again, he softens his expression and lowers his spoon, and she responds with broader facial and hand movements.

observed_facts.text: The dark-haired diner wears a black jacket and charcoal shirt; a flesh-colored two-lobed form hangs under his chin. A silver-topped bottle and cropped stemmed glasses sit in front of him, with wood paneling and seated diners behind.
He brings the spoon to his mouth, closes his lips at its bowl, then withdraws and lowers it. His brow furrows and his eyes briefly close before he looks forward again.
All five samples retain a close frontal view of the man and the same background arrangement, without a visible internal edit.

shots.observed_camera: Close frontal framing at approximately seated eye level; slight compositional variation, with no definite camera movement established.
shots.action_temporality: The ordered samples support spoon-to-mouth contact, withdrawal and a subsequent facial reaction.
uncertainties: Food type and the meaning of his reaction are unknown.
shots.generation_prompt_en: A five-second close view in a dim restaurant with warm amber light and polished wood paneling. The dark-haired diner has swept-back dark hair, a clean-shaven face, a black jacket over an open charcoal shirt, and a conspicuous flesh-colored two-lobed form hanging beneath his chin. He brings a reflective metal spoon to his lips, tastes, then withdraws and lowers it while furrowing his brow. Briefly closing his eyes, he looks forward again. Cropped stemmed glasses and a silver-topped bottle frame the lower edge, with softly focused diners behind him.

adaptations.text: Extend the observed tasting and reaction beat from approximately 2.42 seconds to five seconds with a brief final hold.

observed_facts.text: The blonde diner faces the man across the table, wearing black with small stud earrings and her hair pulled back. His head and shoulder occupy the right foreground; glasses, mirrored wood paneling, a glowing lamp and other diners surround them.

Her mouth changes shape as she maintains her gaze toward the man. Her raised hand shifts from an open gesture near a glass into curled fingers, then briefly opens toward her chest; her brows remain drawn.
The shot begins in a reverse view relative to Shot1 and maintains that same composition throughout its samples.

shots.observed_camera: Stable medium close view over the man's right-foreground shoulder toward the woman.
shots.action_temporality: Multiple samples establish changing mouth shapes and small hand gestures, without establishing spoken words.
uncertainties: No dialogue content is available.

Her blonde hair is swept into a ponytail; she wears small stud earrings and black clothing with an open neckline. Over five seconds, she holds a questioning, knitted-brow expression, moves her lips and makes a small open-hand gesture above the glassware, curling her fingers back toward her chest. Keep the mirrored wood wall, shaded lamp and seated patrons softly visible behind her.

adaptations.text: Pace the sampled expressions and small gestures over five seconds; omit specific dialogue.

observed_facts.text: The man faces the blonde diner, whose ponytail and shoulder fill the left foreground. His two-lobed under-chin form, dark clothing, low-held spoon and the table's stemmed glasses remain visible.
With compressed lips and a furrowed brow, he shifts his eyes sideways, then tilts his head and directs his gaze upward toward screen left while keeping the spoon low.

global_prompt: Four five-second shots: two pedestrians waiting beside traffic; a close view of a striped-shirt man adjusting his posture; a wider seated view with a brief neck-touch gesture; and a return to the same street with the bespectacled man looking around.

observed_facts.text: The bespectacled street man stands left of the patterned-top woman beside a black crossing pole with a yellow button housing. He wears a teal sweatshirt, jeans and backpack, holds the green shopping bag in his right hand and keeps his left hand in his pocket.

The woman holds her black shoulder-bag strap near her shoulder and a pale shopping bag low at her other side. She looks screen right, turns more toward the camera, then faces right again; the man turns from a more forward gaze toward screen right.

Different dark cars occupy the foreground in frames 0, 2 and 4, largely obscuring the pedestrians; frames 1 and 3 reveal them. Vehicle fronts point screen left, but each individual car is sampled only once.
Daylight illuminates the paved crossing, beige stone building, black bollards and yellow roadwork barrier. The street composition remains consistent through the vehicle occlusions.

shots.observed_camera: Approximately eye-level medium-long two-person view from across the road; stable background framing and foreground traffic occlusions. No supported camera movement or internal cut.
shots.action_temporality: Ordered samples show small gaze changes while both pedestrians remain in place, alternating with vehicle occlusions.
uncertainties: Individual vehicle trajectories cannot be tracked between samples.
shots.generation_prompt_en: For five seconds, show a daylight city crossing against a beige stone facade. The Bespectacled street man, a young adult with tousled dark hair, black rectangular glasses, a teal sweatshirt with a small gold chest emblem, blue jeans and a dark backpack, stands beside the black pole and yellow crossing button. His left hand stays in his pocket and his right holds the printed Green shopping bag low. To his right, the Patterned-top woman has dark shoulder-length hair and bangs, a black-and-white patterned tunic and black trousers, a large black shoulder bag and a pale shopping bag. He turns his gaze toward her side; she briefly looks more forward before looking right again. Passing dark traffic intermittently obscures their bodies in the foreground. Keep both on the pavement, with a yellow roadwork barrier at the right edge.

adaptations.text: Slightly extend the 4.84-second source interval to five seconds; retain intermittent traffic without requiring an exact vehicle count or trajectory.

observed_facts.text: A short-haired, bearded man in a white T-shirt with broad rust-red and dark stripes fills a close interior view, with a softly blurred beige wall and leafy plant behind him.
His head and torso lean toward screen left, return nearer the center and change angle again. His mouth position and gaze vary across the samples.

shots.observed_camera: Close head-and-upper-torso framing with shallow background focus and warm side lighting. Subject movement changes the composition; no camera movement or internal edit is established.
shots.action_temporality: Five closely spaced samples support a brief lateral posture adjustment and changing facial pose.
uncertainties: Mouth changes do not establish any words or audible speech.
shots.generation_prompt_en: A warm close view introduces the Striped-shirt seated man, a young adult with short brown hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a white crewneck T-shirt with broad rust-red and dark horizontal stripes. A beige wall and tall leafy plant fall softly out of focus behind him. Over five seconds he makes a small lean toward screen left and settles nearer the center, subtly changing his gaze and mouth position. Preserve the gentle side lighting and intimate head-and-upper-torso framing.

adaptations.text: Expand the 1.72-second source to five seconds by slowing the small posture adjustment and allowing a brief settled pose.

observed_facts.text: The striped-shirt man sits in a gray upholstered armchair wearing dark trousers and a metal left-wrist watch. Dark wooden furniture, a tall vase of flowers and a lamp with a gold-toned base and dark patterned shade stand left; framed pictures hang above and a tall plant fills the right background.

He shifts his hands from the chair sides toward his lap, raises his left hand near his face, then touches the side/back of his neck while tilting his head and looking upward. His left hand subsequently leaves his neck and lowers.
Later he rests both arms beside the chair, then shifts his torso forward and more upright while remaining seated.

shots.observed_camera: Stable medium-wide seated portrait, showing the man from head to upper legs and the surrounding furnishings. The wider view is an adjacent-shot cut from Shot2; no internal framing discontinuity is visible.
shots.action_temporality: Twelve samples show successive seated adjustments, the left-hand neck gesture, lowering of the hand and a later forward shift over 12.72 seconds.
uncertainties: Exact hand paths between the more widely spaced samples are unavailable.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In the same warmly lit room, the Striped-shirt seated man sits in a gray armchair, his striped shirt above dark trousers and a metal watch on his left wrist. Show enough of the room to include dark wooden furniture with flowers and a patterned-shade lamp on the left, framed pictures above and the tall leafy plant on the right. During five seconds he lifts his left hand to the side of his neck, tilts his head and glances upward, then lowers the hand toward the armrest. His right hand remains supported near the other armrest. Keep the seated composition steady.

adaptations.text: Condense the 12.72-second source to the supported neck-touch-and-lower gesture. Omit earlier lap adjustments, the intermediate face gesture and the later forward shift.

observed_facts.text: The bespectacled street man remains beside the same crossing pole, holding the green shopping bag in his right hand with his left hand in his pocket. The patterned-top woman is absent from the visible area.
His gaze changes from screen right to screen left and then more forward/upward while he stays on the pavement. Light-colored vehicles obscure him in frames 1 and 3, between unobstructed views.
The same beige stone facade, tall windows, black street fixtures and yellow construction barrier surround the man throughout the return view.

shots.observed_camera: Medium-long street view with broadly stable composition and minor framing/focus variation around foreground vehicles. No definite camera move or internal cut is indicated.
shots.action_temporality: Ordered samples support scanning gaze changes and intermittent vehicle occlusion, with no observed departure from the pavement.
uncertainties: The woman's departure is not shown.
Individual vehicle travel directions are not established by repeated views of the same vehicle.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Return to the same daylight crossing, where the Bespectacled street man stands alone in the visible waiting area beside the black pole and yellow button. Retain his glasses, teal sweatshirt, jeans and dark backpack, with the Green shopping bag hanging from his right hand and his left hand in his pocket. Over five seconds he looks from screen right toward screen left and then slightly upward and forward. Light-colored traffic briefly obscures him in the foreground. The beige stone facade, black bollards and yellow construction barrier retain their earlier arrangement; he remains on the pavement.

adaptations.text: Extend the 4.92-second interval slightly to five seconds, retaining the gaze changes and intermittent traffic without prescribing exact vehicle trajectories.

title: An embrace in alternating close views
global_prompt: Four five-second shots sustain the embrace, alternate between the two faces, and end with the woman and man drawing slightly apart before kissing.

observed_facts.text: The opening sample is largely obscured by blurred blonde hair; subsequent samples show the man's face above the woman's shoulder as they embrace.
During the embrace, the man's gaze shifts upward and his eyelids lower by the final sample; his brows are raised and drawn together.

His dark wavy hair, mustache, stubble and hoop earring are visible beside her partly pinned blonde waves and pale patterned shoulder. Blue clothing with pale trim appears at lower left; an orange drape hangs behind them.

shots.observed_camera: Tight view over the woman's shoulder toward the man's face. Initial foreground blur gives way to a readable close-up. The samples do not establish a specific camera movement.
shots.action_temporality: Frames 1–4 sustain the embrace while the man's gaze and eyelids change. Frame 0 does not establish the start of the embrace.
uncertainties: The initial obscuration prevents reconstruction of the exact opening movement; no distinct alternate edited view is visible.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In a dim interior beside a rust-orange drape, the Dark-haired man embraces the Blonde woman. He has short wavy dark hair, a narrow mustache, light stubble and a small hoop earring, and wears blue velvet-like period clothing with pale trim. Her long blonde waves are partly pinned back above a pale patterned gown. In a tight view over her shoulder, her hair fills the left foreground and his face remains visible at right. Hold their close embrace as his drawn brows lift, his gaze turns upward, and his eyelids soften toward closing.

adaptations.text: Begin with the readable embrace rather than reproducing the obscured opening sample; gently extend the supported expression changes to five seconds.

observed_facts.text: The reverse view shows the woman's face pressed beside the man's head, his blue-clad back in the foreground, and a gray vertical surround beside a rust-colored background section.
Her hand moves from his upper shoulder and neck to spread across the back of his head. Several ornate gold-colored rings and a pale lace-edged cuff are visible.
With knitted brows and a tightly drawn mouth, she opens her eyes, looks upward, and closes them again while maintaining the embrace.

shots.observed_camera: Stable reverse close-up, woman's face at right and back of man's head at left. The changed view occurs at the supplied shot boundary; no internal cut is evident.
shots.action_temporality: The hand rises between frames 0 and 1 and remains against his hair. Eye and mouth changes continue through frame 4.
shots.generation_prompt_en: The Blonde woman holds the Dark-haired man close in the same dim interior, with the rust-colored background section and gray vertical surround behind them. His dark hair and blue velvet-like back fill the left and lower foreground. Her brows knit and her mouth draws tight as she slides her hand from his upper shoulder to cradle the back of his head, spreading fingers decorated with ornate gold-colored rings; a pale lace-edged cuff frames her wrist. She briefly looks upward, then closes her eyes with her cheek still against him.

adaptations.text: Slow and sustain the sampled hand lift and facial changes from approximately two seconds to five seconds.

observed_facts.text: The view returns to the man's face beside the back of the woman's blonde head, with the same rust-orange drape at right. Their embrace continues.
The man's eyes are initially shut, his mouth opens briefly, and he then opens his eyes while retaining a furrowed brow.

shots.observed_camera: Steady tight close-up returning to the earlier view over the woman's shoulder. No internal framing discontinuity or supported camera travel.
shots.action_temporality: The hug persists across all five samples; closed eyes and a briefly open mouth precede open eyes.
uncertainties: The mouth movement does not establish audible speech or words.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Return to the Dark-haired man's face over the Blonde woman's shoulder, her partly pinned waves filling the left foreground and the rust-orange drape standing behind him at right. They remain wrapped in the same embrace. His eyes stay closed at first, his brow creased; his lips briefly part and settle. He slowly opens his eyes, keeping his face close to her hair and his expression strained.

adaptations.text: Extend the sustained embrace and small facial changes to five seconds; mouth movement carries no specified dialogue.

observed_facts.text: The reverse view returns to the woman's face and her ringed hand holding the man's head, against the repeated rust-colored section and gray surround.
She shifts her ringed hand higher across his hair, brings pursed lips against the side of his head near his ear, then lowers her hand toward his neck.
They ease their heads apart to face each other while her hand stays at his neck, then lean together into a kiss with her eyes closed.

shots.observed_camera: Close reverse view with the woman's face at right. More of both profiles becomes visible as they separate within the framing. No internal cut or specific camera movement is established.
shots.action_temporality: The ordered samples show head cradling, contact near his ear, partial separation, and a final lip kiss. The kiss's release is not shown.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In the same dim interior, the Blonde woman keeps the Dark-haired man close, her ringed hand spread through the back of his short hair. Her eyes close as she presses her lips beside his ear, then her hand slides down toward his neck. They gently ease apart enough to look into each other's faces, her mouth forming a small, tight smile. With her hand still at his neck, they lean together and kiss on the lips. End with them still kissing, against the rust-colored background section and gray surround.

adaptations.text: Gently expand the approximately 3.84-second gesture sequence to five seconds, preserving its order and ending at the visible kiss.

entities.identity_reason: Matching hair, facial hair, earring and blue clothing connect the frontal and reverse views.

title: Blue-lit forest and luminous bud
global_prompt: Four five-second shots show the girl among floating lights, a sustained view of a jagged wooden formation, her downward glance and smile, and her reaching toward a glowing bud.

observed_facts.text: The girl stands slightly right of center in a dark blue forest clearing, framed by thick trunks, shelf fungi, ground mushrooms, foliage and dark foreground roots or fallen wood.

Three prominent cyan lights with soft trailing shapes change position around her. The upper light moves leftward across the early samples; she turns her face upward and toward screen left while slightly lifting one hand.
The girl has dark hair with two front braids and wears a pale sleeveless garment with curved geometric trim near its lower edge.

shots.observed_camera: Wide full-body view with foreground occlusion and broadly stable composition. No internal edited view is apparent in the five samples.
shots.action_temporality: Ordered samples support drifting lights and a gradual upward, leftward head turn with a small hand gesture.
uncertainties: Exact light paths between samples are unavailable.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In a stylized 3D animated forest at night, the Dark-haired girl stands slightly right of center among towering trunks and softly glowing ground vegetation. She has large eyes, dark hair in two front braids, cyan facial markings, and a pale sleeveless tunic with dark geometric trim. Dark roots frame the foreground, with shelf fungi along the left trunk. Three cyan wisps drift at different heights with soft vaporous tails; the highest glides leftward overhead. Over five seconds she tilts her face up toward screen left and lifts one hand slightly, remaining in the clearing. Preserve the wide, layered composition and deep blue lighting.

adaptations.text: Extend the observed head turn, small hand gesture and drifting lights from 2.71 seconds to five seconds without adding another action.

observed_facts.text: A jagged wooden formation fills the image diagonally, with ridged splintered surfaces, pointed upper edges, a dark central gap and small shelf fungi near the bottom.
Cyan light illuminates the lower wood while violet highlights trace its upper ridges. Sparse blue points appear against the dark background; the formation remains essentially unchanged.

shots.observed_camera: Tight upward-looking composition, essentially steady across the samples. This is a distinct cut from Shot1; no internal cut is apparent.
shots.action_temporality: The 1.25-second sample sequence supports a sustained environmental view, without a substantial action.
uncertainties: The formation cannot be matched to a specific object in the surrounding shots.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Hold a five-second upward-looking view of the Jagged wooden formation in a dark animated woodland. Its broad split surface sweeps diagonally across the image, bordered by long pointed splinters and a narrow dark opening. Small pale shelf fungi cling near the lower edges. Cyan illumination reveals the rough lower bark, and violet rim light catches the upper ridges. Keep the wooden formation still, with sparse blue pinpoints visible in the darkness behind it.

adaptations.text: Expand the short environmental insert into a five-second hold; introduce no object movement or spatial connection to the girl.

observed_facts.text: The girl's face fills the frame, showing large green eyes, dark brows, smooth dark blue hair, a bright cyan band across her nose and cheeks, and luminous dots below the band.
Her initially raised gaze and parted lips give way to a downward gaze and small smile. Her mouth changes shape in the later samples.

shots.observed_camera: Tight facial close-up against softly resolved forest trunks and foliage. No clear camera movement or internal cut is established.
shots.action_temporality: The samples support lowering her gaze and softening into a smile, with minor mouth movement.
uncertainties: Mouth movement does not establish speech or dialogue content; the gaze target is outside this framing.
shots.generation_prompt_en: The Dark-haired girl's face fills the view against the dim blue forest. Her large green eyes, thick eyebrows and smooth dark hair surround a glowing cyan stripe across her nose and cheeks, with bright dots beneath it. Over five seconds, her raised gaze lowers, her head dips slightly, and her parted lips settle into a small smile with a brief gentle change in mouth shape. Keep the cool luminous facial markings clearly visible and the forest softly resolved behind her.

adaptations.text: Compress the 6.25-second expression sequence into five seconds, retaining the downward glance and smile without specifying dialogue.

observed_facts.text: The girl appears from her head to upper legs among grooved forest trunks, leafy shrubs and mushrooms, with cyan wisps at different depths. Her two braids, pendant, upper-arm band and tunic trim are visible.
A pointed luminous bud becomes increasingly visible in the lower foreground, with fine cyan-lavender strands and broad curled outer petals.
The girl lowers her body and leans toward the bud while looking down at it. The hand on screen right moves forward until its curved fingers hover near the bud's pointed top; contact is not shown.

shots.observed_camera: Medium view with the girl center-right and the bud entering the lower foreground. Background placement remains broadly stable; no definite camera move or internal cut is established.
shots.action_temporality: Sequential frames show lowering, leaning and a forward reach. They do not establish flower growth, opening or completed touch.
uncertainties: The bud's initial reveal does not establish whether it moves independently.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Back in the blue-lit forest clearing, the Dark-haired girl looks down with a small smile, her two front braids hanging over her pale geometric-trimmed tunic. A large Luminous flower bud occupies the lower foreground, its closed pointed center threaded with cyan and lavender light and cupped by broad curled pale blue petals. Over five seconds she lowers herself and leans toward it, then brings the hand on screen right forward with gently curved fingers, ending just above the bud without touching it. Keep the bud closed. Cyan wisps drift between the dark trunks and the leafy shrub behind her.

adaptations.text: Compress the 6.25-second lowering and reach into five seconds, ending before contact.
Place the bud visibly in the foreground from the start rather than recreating its ambiguous initial reveal.

title: Alternating interior portraits
global_prompt: Preserve the alternating single-person and two-person compositions across six five-second shots, maintaining clothing, backgrounds and restrained facial actions.

observed_facts.text: The bow-tied man is shown chest-up beside a bright window on the left, with greenery and pink flowers beyond it, a curtain edge, and a mottled brown wall on the right. His gray-green jacket, pale striped shirt and patterned bow tie are visible.
His mouth shape changes as his gaze and head dip, return toward screen-right, and lower again near the end.
All five samples retain the same single-person view and background arrangement, with no visible internal edited-view change.

shots.observed_camera: Essentially fixed, eye-level chest-up framing; man left of center with open wall space to his right.
shots.action_temporality: Multiple samples support changing mouth positions and alternating lowered and screen-right gazes; exact intervening movement is unavailable.

shots.generation_prompt_en: A five-second chest-up portrait of the Bow-tied man, an older light-skinned man with thinning swept-back gray-brown hair, a gray-green suit jacket, pale striped shirt and dark patterned bow tie. He is beside a bright window with soft green foliage and pink flowers outside; a curtain borders the window and mottled brown wallpaper fills the right side. He makes small speech-like mouth movements, briefly dips his head and gaze, looks toward screen-right, then lowers his eyes again. Keep the framing steady and his movements restrained. Omit source watermarks and text overlays.

adaptations.text: Extend the approximately 3.50-second source action to five seconds using gentle pacing and brief holds; do not specify dialogue.

observed_facts.text: The striped-tie man stands on the left beside the lavender-jacket woman on the right. Behind them are a stair rail and pale balusters, blue-gray paneling, and a framed picture on a pale yellow wall.
The man maintains a furrowed brow and closed mouth while the woman holds a slightly open smile; both look generally toward screen-left with only slight facial variation.
All samples preserve one chest-up two-person composition. The change from Shot1 is a discrete switch to a different view at the supplied boundary.

shots.action_temporality: The brief source chiefly supports a held reaction, not a substantial completed action.

On the left, the older light-skinned man has short gray hair, strong eyebrows, a finely patterned gray-beige shirt and burgundy-and-gray-green diagonal tie. The light-skinned woman on the right has shoulder-length dark auburn hair and a lavender blazer over a pale open-collar blouse. Both look toward screen-left.
